project.name: Project-1-Soccer-League
project.summary: A terminal batch script reads a roster, balances experience across three teams and writes a practice letter per player. No web server or HTTP routes.

nodes.label: CSV roster input
nodes.summary: The local CSV supplies player fields; record values are outside this map.

nodes.label: Experience-balanced allocation
nodes.summary: open_csv reads dictionaries; build_teams splits experience; assigner cycles three teams separately for each cohort.

nodes.label: Generated practice letters
nodes.summary: generate_letters writes a lowercase underscore-named text file per player, choosing practice time by team.

edges.label: Partition experience and cycle team assignment within each partition.
Write guardian letters from each assigned player dictionary.

steps.note: Read the CSV from the current working directory.
